CLARITY BEFORE COMMITMENT

GOOD TO
KNOW.

A few practical things about joining, visiting, and how we handle your enquiry.

Your questions.
Clear answers.

These are preview policy summaries. Membership terms must be approved by the gym before launch.

Trial visits+

Trial visits are subject to availability. The team confirms your date, timing, and any applicable trial fee before you visit.

Refunds & cancellation+

Ask the team for the written refund and cancellation terms before purchasing a membership.

Membership freeze & transfers+

Membership freeze and transfer requests are subject to the club’s confirmed policy. Contact the front desk before making a payment.

Joining fees & extra charges+

Mock prices shown in ₹. Applicable taxes and final charges must be confirmed by the gym. Personal training is priced separately.

Parking+

Call the front desk for parking guidance before your visit.

Enquiry privacy.

When you request a trial, we save your name, phone number, preferred visit date and time, interested service, and any message you provide. The club’s authorised team uses these details to respond, arrange your visit, and follow up on your enquiry.

Please do not include medical records or detailed health information. Enquiries are not an opt-in to unrelated marketing. You can call +91 99215 87777 to request correction or deletion of your enquiry. Closed enquiries become eligible for automatic deletion after 90 days; active enquiries remain until resolved. Security checks use a hashed network identifier, kept for no more than 24 hours.

We count call and WhatsApp clicks in aggregate to understand which contact options are useful. We do not use advertising trackers. Opening WhatsApp or Google Maps takes you to that provider’s service and privacy policy.

Membership terms

Confirm plan validity, applicable taxes, joining fees, extra services, trial fees, cancellation, refunds, freezes, and transfers with the club before paying. The website does not accept online membership payments or automatically confirm trial bookings.
